title: Zig ELF Linker Improvements Devlog
summary: This devlog documents improvements to the ELF linker implementation in the Zig programming language, covering technical changes to binary linking for Unix-like systems. The article details progress on linker functionality that affects how all Zig programs are compiled into ELF executables on Linux and similar platforms.
problem_solved: Improves the ELF linking process in Zig to make compilation more reliable and efficient for systems programmers.
why_valuable: Linker improvements directly impact compilation speed and binary quality for all Zig developers targeting Unix systems, a core use case for the language.
